resources.string: HyperOS: shows phone notifications on your Xiaomi tablet, for every app. Enable on both devices; pick the apps on the tablet under Settings → Interconnectivity → Notifications → your phone. Also gives Telegram, WhatsApp and every other notification Xiaomi\'s reply box and buttons (formerly XReply).
Forward every app\'s notifications between Xiaomi devices (Interconnectivity) and let them pop up on the tablet.
Xiaomi\'s reply box and buttons for Telegram, WhatsApp and every other notification (formerly XReply). Uninstall XReply if it is still installed.
Changes apply after a reboot (or after restarting System UI and Interconnectivity).
LSPosed is not connected: enable XNotify in LSPosed and open this screen from there.
